card.statement:
Assume that the following conditions hold:

•

For every prime ideal $\mathfrak{p}\subset\Bbbk$, $\mathrm{IC}_{X}(\kappa(\mathfrak{p}))$ is constructible with respect to the stratification $(X_{s})_{s\in\mathscr{S}}$.

•

The function $d:\mathscr{S}\times\mathbb{Z}\to\mathbb{Z}$ given by

$d(s,m)=\rank\mathcal{H}^{-\dim X_{s}-m}(\mathrm{IC}_{X}(\kappa(\mathfrak{p}))_{|X_{s}})$

is independent of $\mathfrak{p}$.

Then the following hold:

(1)

For each $s\in\mathscr{S}$ and each $m\in\mathbb{Z}$, $\mathcal{H}^{m}(j_{s}^{!}\mathrm{IC}_{X}(\Bbbk))$ and $\mathcal{H}^{m}(j_{s}^{*}\mathrm{IC}_{X}(\Bbbk))$ are locally constant sheaves with free stalks. Moreover,

$\rank\mathcal{H}^{-\dim X_{s}+m}(j_{s}^{!}\mathrm{IC}_{X}(\Bbbk))=\rank\mathcal{H}^{-\dim X_{s}-m}(j_{s}^{*}\mathrm{IC}_{X}(\Bbbk))=d(s,m).$

(2)

For every prime ideal $\mathfrak{p}\subset\Bbbk$, we have

$\kappa(\mathfrak{p})\otimes_{\Bbbk}^{L}\mathrm{IC}_{X}(\Bbbk)\cong\mathrm{IC}_{X}(\kappa(\mathfrak{p})).$
card.label: Proposition A

paper.title: Modular intersection cohomology of Drinfeld's compactifications
paper.abstract: We compute the dimension of the cohomology of stalks of intersection cohomology complexes on Zastava schemes and Drinfeld compactifications associated with a connected reductive algebraic group $G$, in case the characteristic of the coefficients field $\Bbbk$ is good for $G$. In particular, we show that these dimensions do not depend on the choice of $\Bbbk$.
